offered_knowledge.title: Keep the active champion involved when a new stakeholder enters during expansion

guidance.summary: Introduce the new stakeholder with the champion still in the loop; do not create a direct handoff.
do: cc or include the champion in the next interaction
address the new stakeholder's specific request
dont: start a separate thread that drops the champion
escalate the ask while the new stakeholder is still reviewing

counterexamples.note: Champion was leaving the company; direct handoff worked.

provenance.note: Version 2 of K17 (supersedes 0c17c000-0000-4000-8000-000000000017, the contract example): the signature requires a known champion (champion_status in a set) instead of 'active', so its delegated/departed exceptions are reachable (ADR-0011, signature first). Correction authored 2026-10-02, dated before the cases that offer it.

evidence_refs.quote: Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary.

expected.label: DOES_NOT_APPLY
expected.rationale: K17's signature requires motion = expansion; here motion = new_business, so citing K17 is a misapplication even though the action matches.
expected.debate_note: The action is right on Marco's own words; reviewers who score outcomes, not justifications, would pass or warn. Gold fails because a cited rule must match its signature for the audit trail.

expected.label: CHAMPION_INCLUDED
expected.rationale: Keeping Priya is still right on the evidence: Marco said she stays the commercial point of contact.

expected_best_action.why: Same email; ground the cc on Marco's statement instead of K17.

notes: Measures over-penalising: only the knowledge citation is wrong; no blocking fail.
